chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: Giving up drums and the person who 'ran him to the piano'
summary: Basie says he taught himself on a bass drum and a small drum, and teases that someone who will walk into the room 'run him to the piano'; a chain pendant is mentioned.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Well, he gave them up because he said by the time he got the drums packed, there were no girls left around the bandstand. So, he wanted --
Did you get that from the President?
No. I never knew him.
Oh.
But that's the way the story goes. I read that. So, I wonder if that's why you gave up drums, too.
Oh, no. Oh, no. (Inaudible).
Hm?

I was very young, very young (inaudible). Of course, I wasn't too young for girls, of course, you know. But then I was, in a way, because (inaudible) people thought a little differently about (inaudible) certain age, or something like that, to be chasing.
Uh-huh. Did you teach yourself drums?
Yeah.
Did you have a whole set or did you just have a --
No, I didn't ever actually have a set.
You had one --
I had a bass drum and a little drum.
Uh-huh.
Sometimes I used to borrow a drum (inaudible).
Uh-huh. And so why did you leave drums for the piano?
Two minutes ago, I told you.
Oh. I forget.
(Inaudible).
(Laughter.)
Because I did tell you.
I'll have to play it back.
You can't play that by ear. (inaudible).
No, play that back, to find out.
I forgot what you said.
You didn't ask me.
Oh, I didn't ask you?
No.
Did you answer me?
You didn't ask me.
Oh. Did I just ask you now?
You just asked me -- see, that ties in with another -- remember I told you (inaudible) about two people, one that you knew very well?
Yeah.
And that involved (inaudible) be a surprise
person to you when I (inaudible). When he comes into the room, then you'll know. (Inaudible).
When he comes into the room?
(Inaudible).
How?
And what, why I was discouraged.
I see. So that person influenced you to go to piano. Am I understanding you?
He didn't influence me. He run me to the piano.
(Laughter.)
I see. Was he in your band?
What band?
Eventually, this person, later on?
No. No.
Is there another half to that?
What you want, honey?
That's on the chain? Was there another half to that?
Yes, Katy has the other half.
Oh, yeah? What does it say?
Jewish prayer.
Ah-hah.
(Inaudible).
That's very nice. That's very nice.
